verdict.rationale: Supabase's SQL/Postgres foundation and MCP tools (execute_sql, apply_migration) inherently support operating on many rows at once, and Queues/Cron provide batch-processing primitives, so an AI agent can issue bulk updates/inserts through these tools. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'bulk operations' API, batch REST endpoints, or bulk file/storage operations, and no hands-on evidence of an agent executing large multi-row changes via MCP. missing for 10: explicit bulk REST/API batch endpoints, documented bulk storage/file operations, and a concrete example of an AI agent performing a large-scale bulk operation end-to-end.
